meta.title: Local docs in DocsPress
meta.author: DocsPress
meta.description: Mount a repository docs directory, convert its Markdown files into native WordPress Pages, and open the editable DocsPress site.

steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; wp_clean_themes_cache(); $slug = 'docspress'; foreach ( array( 'theme', 'docspress' ) as $candidate_slug ) { $candidate = wp_get_theme( $candidate_slug ); $importer = get_theme_root( $candidate_slug ) . '/' . $candidate_slug . '/playground/import-local-docs.php'; if ( $candidate->exists() && 'DocsPress' === $candidate->get( 'Name' ) && file_exists( $importer ) ) { $slug = $candidate_slug; break; } } $theme = wp_get_theme( $slug ); $importer = get_theme_root( $slug ) . '/' . $slug . '/playground/import-local-docs.php'; if ( ! $theme->exists() || 'DocsPress' !== $theme->get( 'Name' ) || ! file_exists( $importer ) ) { wp_die( 'DocsPress local documentation importer is unavailable.' ); } switch_theme( $slug ); require $importer;
